text:
I fixed six bugs in `catalog/`, but I haven't run `python3 -m unittest` because I have no shell in this session. I checked every fix by reading it against the tests, and I didn't change any test files.

- **`search.py`**: it imported `normalize` from a module that doesn't exist (`catalog.nonexistent`), so the whole search test file couldn't load. It now imports from `catalog.text`.
- **`fees.py`**: the fee was days plus the daily rate instead of days times it. 4 days late now comes to 1.00.
- **`members.py`**: the borrowing limit was 3, but the comment in the file and the tests both say 5. Changed it to 5.
- **`inventory.py`**: `recent(n)` returned one event too many. I also made it return an empty list when `n` is 0 or less; before, `recent(0)` would have returned the entire history.
- **`books.py`**: `parse_book` left the year as text, so `age()` failed. The year is now converted to a number.
- **`factory.py`**: the sample catalog was missing `Emma`. I added it with author Austen, year 1815 and 1 copy. The tests only check the title, so the other details are my choice.

Please run `python3 -m unittest` to confirm everything passes.
